name: Sharpened Raptor Tooth procs on melee hits (#11816, #13060)
contract: #11816, #13060: Sharpened Raptor Tooth (proc dummies 304002, 312969, 316969, 320969) never procced. Every
dummy carries Spell.dbc ProcFlags 0 and the world had no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skipped
it. Tooltip: "Your melee hits", tiers "(45sec. internal cooldown)". Flags 20 (melee auto attacks and melee
abilities) as the merged Lightforge 3-piece row. spell_proc_chance reads each loaded entry's chance, which
equals the record's ProcChance, and spell_proc_cooldown_ms reads each loaded cooldown. aura_proc_rate
replays the aura's native proc decision, including the roll, 40000 times on one synthetic event per check.
It procs on a landed melee auto attack, a landed melee ability (Heroic Strike 78), at the record's chance;
it never procs on a landed ranged auto attack, a landed ranged ability (Arcane Shot 3044), a landed direct
magic spell (Frostbolt 116). Before the repair the chance and cooldown lookups fail with 'Spell has no proc
entry' and every rate reads 0, so the discriminating checks fail instead of flaking.
